description: Search Hacker News stories and comments with date, points and comment-count filters, read the live front page and the top, best, new, ask and show lists in rank order, or read whole comment threads. Every item links back to news.ycombinator.com.

content_type.description: search mode: stories (default), comments or both

date_from.description: Only items from this day on (UTC), YYYY-MM-DD

date_to.description: Only items up to the end of this day (UTC), YYYY-MM-DD

include_story.description: story_comments mode: false to leave the story itself out (default true)

max_items.description: How many items, 1 to 50 (default 20; 50 for story_comments; front_page stops at 30)

min_comments.description: Stories with at least this many comments

min_points.description: Stories with at least this many points

mode.description: search (default), front_page, top, best, new, ask, show or story_comments

query.description: search mode: keywords. Empty matches everything the filters allow

search_in.description: search mode: all (default), title, url or text

sort_by.description: search mode: relevance (default) or date (newest first)

story_ids.description: story_comments mode: up to 5 item ids or news.ycombinator.com links, separated by commas

name: search_hacker_news
title: Search Hacker News
